summary: Checked 38 claims across line refs, function names, package patterns, and DDL assertions. findings.claim: tech-spec Tasks 2 and Acceptance Criteria (line 349) say to UPDATE tests/test_migration.py::EXPECTED_PUBLISHED_COLUMNS to include model_fingerprint; tech-spec line 288 lists this in Testing Strategy
findings.reality: tests/test_migration.py defines ONLY EXPECTED_PENDING_COLUMNS (line 38). There is NO EXPECTED_PUBLISHED_COLUMNS constant in test_migration.py — only EXPECTED_PENDING. test_migration.py covers published_articles existence (line 112) but not its column schema. The published-schema pin DOES exist as EXPECTED_PUBLISHED in tests/test_pending_articles_repo.py:53 (verified).
findings.source: tech-spec.md Testing Strategy line 288, Acceptance Criteria line 349, Task 2 line 371
findings.fix: Either (a) reword to say 'add EXPECTED_PUBLISHED_COLUMNS to test_migration.py' and 'update EXPECTED_PUBLISHED in test_pending_articles_repo.py:53', or (b) drop the test_migration.py::EXPECTED_PUBLISHED_COLUMNS reference and update only test_pending_articles_repo.py::EXPECTED_PUBLISHED (which is the existing published-schema pin).

findings.claim: tech-spec Task 5 says 'tests/test_integration.py (_PrepPhaseBase pattern at lines 88-136)'
findings.reality: _PrepPhaseBase class is defined at tests/test_integration.py:115-136 (verified). Lines 88-114 belong to _IntegrationBase (its parent class), not _PrepPhaseBase.
findings.fix: Update line reference to '_PrepPhaseBase at lines 115-136' (or '_IntegrationBase + _PrepPhaseBase at lines 88-136' if both are intended).

findings.claim: Decision 9 line 154: 'URL-equality at news_bot.py:1779-1782 already prevents same-link self-match'
findings.reality: Lines 1779-1782 contain a pending-articles existence filter ([e for e in new_entries if pending_repo.get_pending(e.get('link')) is None]), NOT a URL-equality check between candidates. The de facto effect (preventing the same link from re-entering processing) is achieved through this filter combined with filter_new_entries (processed_news check) at line 1777. The label 'URL-equality' is slightly misleading — it is URL-existence-in-pending-table.
findings.fix: Optional reword for clarity: 'URL-existence check against pending_articles at news_bot.py:1779-1782 (combined with filter_new_entries processed_news check at 1777) prevents same-link self-match.'
